parameters.content:
## SETUP — ONE SEPARATE QR WORKFLOW
1. Node **11**: set LECTURER_PIN.
2. Nodes **15 and 26**: assign SAME n8n Header Auth credential (name **X-Proxy-Key**, value your private proxy key).
3. Node **24**: only if SIS IDs fail, map SIS IDs to owner-provided Qwickly user IDs.
4. **Activate/publish workflow**. Static data is not saved in manual test runs.
5. Open the lecturer URL, create a session, display QR.
6. Set app `EXPO_PUBLIC_STUDENT_CHECKIN_API_URL=https://fyp-workflow.swin.click/webhook/fyp/qr/checkin` and rebuild.
7. App must send Microsoft Graph User.Read bearer token.

**DO NOT** put proxy key in Expo env. Admin workflow is untouched.

parameters.content:
## PROXY GUIDE CONTRACT
CREATE: POST `https://workflow.swin.click/webhook/qwickly-proxy-session/course/2244/session` → expects `201` + `session_id`.
RECORD: POST `https://workflow.swin.click/webhook/qwickly-proxy/course/2244/session/{sessionId}/record` → expects `201` + record id, parent_session, user_id, status_id 286.

**Never claim success** on 200/400/401/404/409/502. HTTP 409 means already exists.

For FYP demo only: random QR proof stored with workflow staticData; one active class per workflow; staticData may be unreliable under concurrent scans. Use n8n Data Tables for production-grade session state.
